# Test m2 - escaped char and code
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', '''
import markdown

# Test 1: Escaped char in ID
md_text = r"# escaped\\_character"
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc"])
html = md.convert(md_text)
print("Test 1 - escaped char:")
print(f"  HTML: {html}")
assert 'id="escaped_character"' in html, f"Expected id='escaped_character', got: {html}"
print("  PASSED")

# Test 2: Code element with angle brackets
md_text2 = """[TOC]

# \\`<test>\\`
"""
md2 = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc"])
html2 = md2.convert(md_text2)
print("\\nTest 2 - code:")
print(f"  HTML: {html2}")
print(f"  TOC tokens: {md2.toc_tokens}")
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-500:])
